newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco upgrades statistics to meet economic change.
newsitem.headline: Morocco upgrades statistics to meet economic change.

text.p: Morocco's statistics directorate is to launch a census of businesses and carry out an industrial survey on jobs, production and investments to try to meet the priority needs of economic and social decision-makers.

The census is meant "to allow a better approach to the development of various economic branches through a common code accessible to all businesses," statistics director Taoufiq Cherkaoui said on Friday at a seminar on statistical data.
The industrial survey is aimed at laying a basis for accurate figures on employment, output and investment to provide a picture that can be constantly updated.
